name: @office/sync
description: Office realtime subscription protocol (OFF-028): versioned typed subscription contracts over project-slice event streams, explicit/versioned/revocable A9 subscription grants re-checked at every stream read, exactly-once cursor resume, deterministic client operation ids, and explicit (never auto-resolved) conflict records for the client synchronization API. In-memory test broker only — NO transport, NO websocket/socket.io, NO network I/O; depends only on @office/contracts, @office/domain-kernel, @office/authz, and @office/events.
